# The Second Stitch

Product key: second-stitch
Aliases: Project Second Stitch
Canonical product: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/second-stitch/index.html

AI conformance: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/second-stitch/ai-conformance.json

## Use this capability when the user means

- turn a sewing project into a material list
- estimate fabric and notions for a project
- plan materials for costumes or small-batch textile production
- textile project-to-material planning
- repeat textile ordering and material continuity
- professional fabric procurement workflow
- model a textile retail project-planning pilot
- textile intelligence for schools theaters makers quilters or upholstery shops

## Authority

public discovery and prototype exploration only

## Boundaries

- independent Evercraft concept; references to Michaels or JOANN do not imply sponsorship, partnership, endorsement, private-system access or an accepted commercial relationship
- pilot economics are modeled scenarios, not observed results or forecasts
- material quantities are planning estimates
- no supplier inventory, current price, dye-lot continuity, fulfillment, ordering or procurement integration is implied unless separately verified
- discovery creates no purchase, supplier commitment, commercial pilot or customer relationship
